cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Read the first line of this letter before I do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Only if your face stays reasonably ordinary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sit beside you. We can take one line at a time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep hold of the page too. I'll follow your finger. No need to ask why I'm taking so long.

mechanism: A uses expert instructions to delegate emotional work while refusing to spell out its weight.
confusable: Simple task delegation lacks the emotional vulnerability visible beneath A's strained management of the helper.
comparison: A restaurant cancellation delegates speaking; a difficult letter delegates the first encounter with news.
seedUse: Use the cancellation and letter seeds as emotional tasks; make apparent expertise a way of asking indirectly for support.
